premise: Dog thinks Sandpiper's running back and forth with the waves is a game, gets splashed, and learns the waves leave Sandpiper's snacks in the wet sand.
inspiration: The imitation fables (Aesop's ass who copied the lapdog) turned kind: copying a friend ends in a splash, a laugh and each one's own game.
lesson: Everyone has their own reasons, and their own fun.
learning: Sandpipers run after the waves to find tiny food in the wet sand.

en-US.title: Chasing the Waves
en-US.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Sandpiper was running along the shore. {sandpiper:pulse} Down to the water… {sandpiper:go to shore another} back up again. Down… back! {dog:enter} Dog watched, {dog:face surprised} his head on one side. [excited] A game! {dog:go to shore} He bounded down to join in. Down to the water… {sfx:splash} SPLASH! A wave washed right over his paws. {dog:face surprised} {dog:live shake} Dog shook himself dry, shake, shake, shake. [laughs] {sandpiper:live shake-head} It isn't a game, said Sandpiper. {sandpiper:face happy} Every wave leaves tiny things to eat, just where the water has been. {sandpiper:live peck hold} So I run in, peck, peck, peck, and run out before the next one comes! {dog:face happy} Oh, said Dog. {dog:live nod} So that's your snack. [short pause] Then he grinned, and fetched {ball:enter} his ball. {dog:go to ball} {dog:hop x2} [playfully] And THIS, said Dog, is my favourite thing. {ball:live spin} The ball spun round, red and yellow and blue and white. {dog:hearts}

es-ES.title: Persiguiendo las olas
es-ES.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Correlimos corría por la orilla. {sandpiper:pulse} Hasta el agua… {sandpiper:go to shore another} y otra vez arriba. ¡Abajo… arriba! {dog:enter} Perro lo miraba, {dog:face surprised} con la cabeza ladeada. [excited] ¡Un juego! {dog:go to shore} Bajó dando brincos para jugar. Hasta el agua… {sfx:splash} ¡CHOF! Una ola le mojó las patas. {dog:face surprised} {dog:live shake} Perro se sacudió, sacude, sacude, sacude. [laughs] {sandpiper:live shake-head} No es un juego, dijo Correlimos. {sandpiper:face happy} Cada ola deja cositas de comer justo donde ha pasado el agua. {sandpiper:live peck hold} ¡Así que entro corriendo, pico, pico, pico, y salgo antes de que llegue la siguiente! {dog:face happy} Ah, dijo Perro. {dog:live nod} Así que esa es tu merienda. [short pause] Entonces sonrió y fue a buscar {ball:enter} su pelota. {dog:go to ball} {dog:hop x2} [playfully] Y ESTO, dijo Perro, es lo que más me gusta. {ball:live spin} La pelota dio vueltas, roja, amarilla, azul y blanca. {dog:hearts}

ja-JP.title: 波と おいかけっこ
ja-JP.text: {sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:go to shore}シギくんが、波打ち際をはしっています。{sandpiper:pulse}水のほうへ、ちょこちょこ…{sandpiper:go to shore another}またもどって。いって…もどって！{dog:enter}イヌくんは、{dog:face surprised}くびをかしげて見ていました。[excited]「たのしそう！ぼくもまぜて！」 {dog:go to shore}イヌくんも、かけおりていきます。水のほうへ…{sfx:splash}ざぶーん！波が、あしにざばっとかかりました。{dog:face surprised}{dog:live shake}イヌくんは、ぶるぶるぶるっと水をはらいます。[laughs]{sandpiper:live shake-head}「あそびじゃないよ」 とシギくん。{sandpiper:face happy}「水がひいたところには、小さなごはんがのこるんだ。{sandpiper:live peck hold}だから、はしっていって、つん、つん、つん。つぎの波がくるまえに、にげるのさ！」 {dog:face happy}「へえ！」 とイヌくん。{dog:live nod}「それが、きみのおやつなんだね」 [short pause]それからイヌくんはにっこりして、じぶんの{ball:enter}ビーチボールをとってきました。{dog:go to ball}{dog:hop x2}[playfully]「で、ぼくのだいすきなのは、これ！」 {ball:live spin}ボールがくるくるまわります。あか、きいろ、あお、しろ。{dog:hearts}

de-DE.title: Wettlauf mit den Wellen
de-DE.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Der Strandläufer rannte am Ufer entlang. {sandpiper:pulse} Runter zum Wasser… {sandpiper:go to shore another} und wieder rauf. Runter… und rauf! {dog:enter} Der Hund schaute zu, {dog:face surprised} den Kopf schief gelegt. [excited] Ein Spiel! {dog:go to shore} Er sprang hinunter, um mitzumachen. Runter zum Wasser… {sfx:splash} PLATSCH! Eine Welle schwappte ihm über die Pfoten. {dog:face surprised} {dog:live shake} Der Hund schüttelte sich trocken, schüttel, schüttel, schüttel. [laughs] {sandpiper:live shake-head} „Das ist doch kein Spiel“, sagte der Strandläufer. {sandpiper:face happy} „Jede Welle lässt winzige Leckerbissen liegen, genau da, wo das Wasser war. {sandpiper:live peck hold} Also renne ich hin, pick, pick, pick, und renne wieder weg, bevor die nächste kommt!“ {dog:face happy} „Ach so“, sagte der Hund. {dog:live nod} „Das ist also dein Pausenbrot.“ [short pause] Dann grinste er und holte {ball:enter} seinen Wasserball. {dog:go to ball} {dog:hop x2} [playfully] „Und DAS“, sagte der Hund, „ist mein Allerliebstes.“ {ball:live spin} Der Ball drehte sich, rot und gelb und blau und weiß. {dog:hearts}

fr-FR.title: Le jeu des vagues
fr-FR.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Bécasseau courait le long du rivage. {sandpiper:pulse} Il filait jusqu’à l’eau… {sandpiper:go to shore another} et il remontait en courant. Aller… retour ! {dog:enter} Chien le regardait, {dog:face surprised} la tête penchée. [excited] Un jeu ! {dog:go to shore} Il a bondi jusque-là pour jouer, lui aussi. Jusqu’à l’eau… {sfx:splash} PLOUF ! Une vague lui a mouillé les pattes. {dog:face surprised} {dog:live shake} Chien s’est secoué pour se sécher, et que je te secoue, et que je te secoue ! [laughs] {sandpiper:live shake-head} « Ce n’est pas un jeu, a dit Bécasseau. {sandpiper:face happy} Chaque vague laisse de toutes petites choses à manger, juste là où l’eau est passée. {sandpiper:live peck hold} Alors je cours, pic, pic, pic, et je remonte avant la vague suivante ! » {dog:face happy} « Ah, a dit Chien. {dog:live nod} Alors, c’est ton goûter ! » [short pause] Puis il a fait un grand sourire, et il est allé chercher {ball:enter} son ballon. {dog:go to ball} {dog:hop x2} [playfully] « Et ÇA, a dit Chien, c’est ce que je préfère au monde ! » {ball:live spin} Le ballon a tourné, tourné, rouge et jaune, bleu et blanc. {dog:hearts}

it-IT.title: Rincorrere le onde
it-IT.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Piovanello correva lungo la riva. {sandpiper:pulse} Giù verso l'acqua… {sandpiper:go to shore another} e di nuovo su. Giù… e su! {dog:enter} Cane lo guardava, {dog:face surprised} con la testa piegata di lato. [excited] Un gioco! {dog:go to shore} È corso giù a grandi balzi, per giocare anche lui. Giù verso l'acqua… {sfx:splash} SPLASH! Un'onda gli ha bagnato tutte le zampe. {dog:face surprised} {dog:live shake} Cane si è scrollato per asciugarsi, scrolla, scrolla, scrolla. [laughs] {sandpiper:live shake-head} «Non è un gioco», ha detto Piovanello. {sandpiper:face happy} «Ogni onda lascia tante cosine da mangiare, proprio dove è passata l'acqua. {sandpiper:live peck hold} Così io corro giù, becco qui, becco là, e scappo su prima che arrivi la prossima!» {dog:face happy} «Ah», ha detto Cane. {dog:live nod} «Allora quella è la tua merenda.» [short pause] Poi ha sorriso, ed è andato a prendere {ball:enter} il suo pallone. {dog:go to ball} {dog:hop x2} [playfully] «E QUESTO», ha detto Cane, «è il mio gioco preferito!» {ball:live spin} Il pallone girava girava, rosso, giallo, blu e bianco. {dog:hearts}

zh-TW.title: 追著浪花跑
zh-TW.text: {sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:go to shore}濱鷸在岸邊跑來跑去。{sandpiper:pulse}跑向水邊……{sandpiper:go to shore another}再跑回來。過去……回來！{dog:enter}小狗看著看著，{dog:face surprised}歪著頭。[excited]「是遊戲耶！」 {dog:go to shore}牠蹦蹦跳跳衝下去，也要一起玩。跑向水邊……{sfx:splash}嘩啦！一道浪衝上來，把牠的腳打得濕答答。{dog:face surprised}{dog:live shake}小狗用力甩甩身體，甩、甩、甩。[laughs]{sandpiper:live shake-head}濱鷸說：「這不是遊戲啦。」 {sandpiper:face happy}「每一道浪退回去，剛剛水來過的地方，就會留下小小的東西給我吃。{sandpiper:live peck hold}所以我衝過去，啄、啄、啄，趁下一道浪還沒來，趕快跑回來！」 {dog:face happy}「喔——」 小狗說，{dog:live nod}「原來那是你的點心呀。」 [short pause]接著，小狗咧嘴一笑，叼來{ball:enter}牠的沙灘球。{dog:go to ball}{dog:hop x2}[playfully]「這個呢，」 小狗說，「是我最最喜歡的東西！」 {ball:live spin}球骨碌碌轉呀轉，紅的、黃的、藍的、白的。{dog:hearts}

zh-HK.title: 追浪
zh-HK.text: {sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:go to shore}濱鷸在岸邊跑來跑去。{sandpiper:pulse}浪退了，牠就追下去……浪來了，{sandpiper:go to shore another}牠又跑回來。浪退，追！浪來，走！{dog:enter}小狗在一旁看着，{dog:face surprised}歪起了頭。[excited]「一定係追浪遊戲！」 {dog:go to shore}牠蹦蹦跳跳地跑下去，也要玩。浪退了，牠也追下去……{sfx:splash}嘩啦！一個浪撲過來，把牠的腳全弄濕了。{dog:face surprised}{dog:live shake}小狗用力抖，抖、抖、抖，把水都抖掉。[laughs]{sandpiper:live shake-head}「唔係遊戲呀，」 濱鷸說。{sandpiper:face happy}「每次浪退咗，啱啱浸過水嘅地方，就有好多細細粒嘅嘢食。{sandpiper:live peck hold}所以我跑落去，啄、啄、啄，趁下一個浪未嚟，又跑返上嚟！」 {dog:face happy}「哦——」 小狗說。{dog:live nod}「原來係你嘅下午茶！」 [short pause]然後，牠咧嘴一笑，叼來{ball:enter}自己的沙灘波。{dog:go to ball}{dog:hop x2}[playfully]「我最鍾意嘅，」 小狗說，「就係呢個！」 {ball:live spin}沙灘波轉呀轉，紅、黃、藍、白。{dog:hearts}

splash.prompt: a small wave washing up over a dog's paws on wet sand, a light splash, realistic
